# Demo games and their QR codes

Every demo is a normal QRG program (see `games/`). The QR code holds the URL of the hosting page plus the compressed game, so scanning it
with any phone camera opens the game. Sizes are measured for the current compressor and the hosting URL `https://animuok.lt/APPS/G/#`.

| Game | What it is | Code (minified) | URL length | QR code |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tetris | Falling blocks. Swipe to move, tap to rotate, hold down to drop. | 1509 B | 885 | v17 (85×85) |
| Racing | Dodge the traffic. Drag to steer. | 981 B | 585 | v13 (69×69) |
| Breakout | Drag the paddle, tap to launch the ball. | 801 B | 536 | v13 (69×69) |
| Snake | Swipe to steer. Eat, grow, do not crash. | 703 B | 459 | v12 (65×65) |
| Flappy | Tap to flap through the pipes. | 641 B | 416 | v11 (61×61) |
| Invaders | Drag to move, hold to shoot. | 1242 B | 704 | v15 (77×77) |
| Pong | Drag the paddle up and down. | 702 B | 443 | v11 (61×61) |
| Runner | Tap to jump over the cacti. | 597 B | 407 | v11 (61×61) |
| 2048 | Swipe to merge tiles. | 999 B | 704 | v15 (77×77) |
| Stack | Tap to drop the sliding block. | 514 B | 372 | v10 (57×57) |
| Tactics | Turn-based strategy. Tap a unit, tap a lit square to move, tap a red enemy to attack. | 3133 B | 2054 | v27 (125×125) |
| Tiny Pet | A pocket pet in real time: feed it twice a day. It lives on while the game is closed. | 4262 B | 2832 | v33 (149×149) |

A QR code holds at most about 4300 alphanumeric characters (version 40). Smaller QR codes scan faster and from further away:
version 10 is 57 × 57 modules, version 20 is 97 × 97, version 30 is 137 × 137.
